completionFence: gl.finish followed by full-viewport RGBA readPixels. Timed cost includes the readback copy; no pure GPU timer is claimed.
sourceFreeze: git show exact R3 commit, independent of concurrent R4 working-tree edits

visualReview.contactRender: Original PNGs scaled to360x640 with bilinear interpolation for equal-size internal inspection; native-resolution PNGs remain untouched.
visualReview.size640: Best mineral cracks, distant veins and engraving detail.
visualReview.size384: Preserves depth, recognizable lamps/veins and rock silhouette, with visible softness and weaker bar engraving.
visualReview.size320: Further silhouette stair-stepping and noticeably weaker fine engraving; lower cost but more quality loss.

provisionalRecommendation.scope: Recognized software renderer only; a candidate tier for Android verification, not acceptance or a physical GPU default.
provisionalRecommendation.reason: Cuts pixel count64% and observed completion+readback median from11.9ms to5.0ms; tunnelP95 from22.1ms to9.0ms, while preserving more detail than320.

invalidPilot.reason: Near-zero finish-only timings failed the observable completion sanity check.

limitations: Desktop software completion costs are not Android/physical GPU/compositor timings or FPS.
Full RGBA readback, when enabled, is included as an observable completion fence and adds transfer overhead.
Finish-only near-zero measurements do not demonstrate raster completion and must not determine a tier.
Single host and ordered conditions, no randomization or cross-run statistical acceptance.
Warmup excludes shader compilation; no native lifecycle, input or fallback transition is exercised.
Pixel dimensions and screenshots expose the visual-quality tradeoff; a budget hit is not device acceptance.
